sources.name: World Checklist of Vascular Plants v16
sources.licenseEvidence: README_WCVP.xlsx in the actual source archive states CC BY 3.0; the GBIF Darwin Core distribution advertises CC BY 4.0. This import uses the archive license.
sources.citation: Govaerts R (ed.). 2026. WCVP: World Checklist of Vascular Plants. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. https://doi.org/10.34885/egs6-cp24
sources.modifications: Accepted tree species subset; native/extant/non-doubtful country records only; normalized names and identifiers; procedural archetypes not botanical evidence.

sources.name: TDWG WGSRPD Level 3 botanical countries
sources.citation: Brummitt, R.K. (2001). World Geographical Scheme for Recording Plant Distributions, Edition 2. TDWG / Hunt Institute.
sources.modifications: Source geometry retained; bounding boxes added. These old coarse botanical boundaries can differ from RESOLVE coastlines.

selection: Priority original and distinctive taxa, followed by deterministic round-robin across botanical regions with genus diversity; not abundance, dominance, or an exhaustive flora.
